'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]] tells [[civilians]] to evacuate parts of eastern [[Rafah]] ahead of a planned [[Rafah offensive|ground invasion]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68964103 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/may/06/middle-east-crisis-live-updates-today-rafah-evacuation-gaza-israel-hamas-war-palestine (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Hamas]] states that it has accepted a ceasefire proposal negotiated by [[Egypt]] and [[Qatar]]. Israel rejects the proposal, claiming that the deal does not meet its "core demands", but confirms that it will continue negotiations in [[Cairo]], Egypt. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/rafah-live-gazans-start-leaving-parts-southern-city-israel-warns-operation-2024-05-06/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-humanitarian-aid-8659eae6e0a7362504f0aa4aa4be53e0 (AP)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two IDF soldiers of the [[98th Paratroopers Division]]'s 655th Battalion were killed in a Hezbollah drone strike near [[Metula]], [[northern Israel]], bringing the IDF death toll of the conflict start to 18.[https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-two-troops-dead-after-hezbollah-drone-attack-on-metula-monday/ (Times of Israel)] and 30 rockets are fired at [[Kidmat Tzvi]], Golan Heights, [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-05-06/ty-article/.premium/thirty-rockets-fired-at-israels-north-by-hezbollah-drone-explodes-in-metula/0000018f-4d4c-dd3a-a5cf-7f7feeb20000 (Haaretz)] **Three injured in IDF strikes on 15 Radwan targets including a factory in [[al-Lwaiza]] and a Hezbollah compound in [[Sefri]], near [[Baalbek]] in [[southern Lebanon]].[https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/explosive-laden-drone-launched-by-hezbollah-from-lebanon-hits-near-metula/ [(The Times of Israel)]. 
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Six people are killed and 35 others are injured in [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] in [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/05/06/6-killed-in-ukrainian-drone-attack-on-russias-belgorod-a85041 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]]
***The [[Turkish Air Force]] carries out [[airstrike]]s on [[Iraqi Kurdistan]], reportedly killing 16 [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|PKK]] insurgents. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-strikes-northern-iraq-air-says-it-kills-pkk-members-2024-05-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The 2024 [[Met Gala]] takes place at the [[Metropolitan Museum of Art]] in [[New York City]] with the theme "The Garden of Time", celebrating the Met's exhibit ''[[Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion]]''. [https://www.vanityfair.com/live/met-gala-2024-live-updates (''Vanity Fair'')]
*The [[2024 Pulitzer Prize|2024]] [[Pulitzer Prize]] ceremony is held, with 16 awards in Journalism and 10 in Letters, Drama, & Music. [https://www.npr.org/2024/05/06/1248897860/pulitzer-prize-winners-2024 (NPR)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Steward Health Care]], a for-profit hospital chain in the [[United States]], files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/boston/news/steward-health-care-bankruptcy/ (CBS News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing heavy flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 85. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-brazil-downpours-climbs-83-2024-05-06/ (Reuters)]
*An under construction [[Apartment building collapse in George|apartment building collapses]] in [[George, South Africa]], killing 34 people and injuring 16 others. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-building-collapse-rescue-64a326da97080e86c90727278c39b69b (AP)]
*Five workers are killed and another is critically injured while carrying out maintenance work on a [[wastewater]] lifting [[Water tank|tank]] in [[Palermo]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.palermotoday.it/cronaca/operai-morti-feriti-casteldaccia.html (Palermo Today)]
*[[Tornado outbreak of May 6–10, 2024]]
**The [[U.S.]] [[Storm Prediction Center]] issues a rare [[List of Storm Prediction Center high risk days|high risk convective outlook]] ahead of an expected significant [[Tornado outbreak|tornado outbreak]] in parts of [[Oklahoma]] and [[Kansas]]. [https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/archive/2024/day1otlk_20240506_1300.html (Storm Prediction Center)]
**An EF4 tornado strikes the cities of [[Barnsdall, Oklahoma|Barnsdall]] and [[Bartlesville, Oklahoma]], killing one and leaving one other missing. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/interactive/2024/deadly-tornado-strikes-oklahoma/ (Washington Post)]

'''Law and crime'''
*An [[America]]n soldier is arrested in Russia on charges of criminal misconduct. According to US officials, the soldier was based in [[South Korea]] and had been accused of stealing from a woman. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-soldier-detained-russia-us-official-says-2024-05-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses]]
***[[Japan]]ese students at the [[University of Tokyo]], [[Sophia University]], [[Tama Art University]], [[International  Christian University]], and [[Hiroshima University]] hold solidarity encampments. [https://www.arabnews.jp/en/japan/article_121189/ (''Arab News Japan'')]
***[[Belgium|Belgian]] and [[Netherlands|Dutch]] students hold solidarity encampments and occupy parts of the [[Ghent University]], the [[University of Amsterdam]], and [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belgian-dutch-students-join-gaza-protest-wave-2024-05-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Chadian presidential election]]
**[[Chad]] holds presidential elections under [[National Transitional Council (Chad)|its junta]], contested between incumbent [[Mahamat Déby]] and [[List of prime ministers of Chad|Prime Minister]] [[Succès Masra]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/who-are-main-candidates-chads-election-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/6/president-vs-prime-minister-whats-at-stake-in-chad-presidential-election (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Scottish National Party leadership election]]
**[[John Swinney]] is elected [[leader of the Scottish National Party]] following the resignation of [[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Humza Yousaf]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/article/2024/may/06/john-swinney-becomes-snp-leader-after-rival-drops-out (''The Guardian'')]
